title: CommutePH
description: Helps commuters find the right terminals for their journey, across buses, trains, jeepneys and bikes.

title: Pagpag: The Hunger Games
description: A 2D survival game set in a Filipino slum: survive 365 days, find a stable job and escape. Hardcore mode: one life, no second chances.

caseStudy.problem: The pitch, from the game's title screen: "No money, no choices. Just survival." Survive 365 days, find a stable job and escape the slums.

features.title: Character creation
features.description: Play as Dong or Inday, a husband and wife who each have their own backstory.

features.title: Hardcore save
features.description: One persistent run in a single save slot.

features.title: Playable world map
features.description: A world scene the player explores between locations.

features.title: Jobs and minigames
features.description: Earn money through labor, service and street minigames at locations around the map.

features.title: Family management
features.description: Feed the family and send the children to work jobs on their own; their skills and energy decide how well they do.

outcomes: Designed and built a complete 2D survival game in Unity 6, from main menu to world map, minigames and family system.
Playable in the browser straight from the portfolio, with no download or install.
